description: This file defines client-side query functions for the ERPNext web application, including functions to generate queries for users, leads, customers, suppliers, items, BOMs, tasks, contacts, addresses, warehouses, and dimensions, as well as setup functions for configuring query filters in forms.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Returns the query for fetching users.

methods.name: lead
methods.description: Returns the query for fetching leads.

methods.name: customer
methods.description: Returns the query for fetching customers.

methods.name: supplier
methods.description: Returns the query for fetching suppliers.

methods.name: item
methods.description: Returns the query for fetching items with optional filters.

methods.name: bom
methods.description: Returns the query for fetching BOMs.

methods.name: task
methods.description: Returns the query for fetching tasks.

methods.name: customer_filter
methods.description: Generates filters for customer based on document data.

methods.name: contact_query
methods.description: Generates contact query with dynamic link validation.

methods.name: address_query
methods.description: Generates address query with dynamic link validation.

methods.name: company_address_query
methods.description: Returns address query filtered for the company's address.

methods.name: supplier_filter
methods.description: Generates filters for supplier based on document data.

methods.name: lead_filter
methods.description: Generates filters for lead based on document data.

methods.name: not_a_group_filter
methods.description: Returns filter to exclude group entries.

methods.name: employee
methods.description: Returns the query for fetching employees.

methods.name: warehouse
methods.description: Returns warehouse filters based on company and group status.

methods.name: get_filtered_dimensions
methods.description: Returns query filters for dimensions based on child fields and company.
